text:
Priya (Onboarding Lead): Kicking off Novus Retail onboarding. Target: pilot in 30 days, handoff day 45. Need stakeholders, success criteria, and blockers. Quick availability for 30m kickoff?

Aisha (CSM): Free tomorrow 10-11am PT. I9ll own health cadence and 30/60/90.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Tomorrow 10am PT works. Need infra POC (VPC/NAT/allowlist).

Sam - Novus (Customer): 10am ok. Our infra folks are EST afternoons; will share POC.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Draft success criteria: 1) API integration in sandbox, 2) 95th pct latency <300ms for 512 tokens in pilot env, 3) acceptance tests on ~10k prompts, 4) enablement + docs delivered, 5) baseline MAU for renewal signal. Additions?

Maya (Renewals): Add MAU target & steady request rate. Note: Novus has internal cost review next quarter 1 potential renewal risk.

Marco (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist: API key, test model pinned (recommend redwood/llama-100b-quant), sample payloads, load test plan. Quick sanity curl after key:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Priya (Onboarding Lead): @calendar-bot please create 30m kickoff tomorrow 1:30pm ET / 10:30am PT. Agenda: intros, confirm criteria, infra checklist, milestones & owners.

calendar-bot: Created event "Novus Retail 1 Onboard Kickoff" 2026-04-14 13:30 ET.

Liam (Enablement): I9ll prepare enablement pack + 45m recorded training; suggest training on day 7 after integration.

Sam - Novus (Customer): Will share S3 link for labeled prompts (~12k) before kickoff and confirm VPC preference by EOD.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Actions:
- Sam: infra POC + S3 prompts link (before kickoff)
- Marco: tech checklist + load-test template (1 day post-kickoff)
- Aisha: 30/60/90 plan + MAU targets (3 days)
- Liam: enablement pack + recording (day 7)
- Maya: set renewal_watch in CRM and note cost-review window

Aisha (CSM): I9ll also schedule a day-14 pulse survey for early feedback.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): Risk: private deployment need adds ~3-4 weeks. @Sam confirm preference by EOD.

Maya (Renewals): Marking private-deploy possibility as medium risk until confirmed.

Marco (Solutions Eng): If VPC needed, we9ll run infra sync right after kickoff; have migration runbook ready.

Priya (Onboarding Lead): I9ll run the kickoff and share notes + owner tracker after. Thanks :thumbsup:

Aisha (CSM): Thanks, see you tomorrow.

Liam (Enablement): +1, will bring enablement roadmap.

Sam - Novus (Customer): See you at kickoff.
